title: CretSpec project manifest
description: Schema version 1 names one code repository. Schema version 2 names any number of repositories; the spec repository may also contain product code. Schema version 3 adds typed references to further guidelines and other CretSpec projects.

repositoryName.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Roles refer to repositories by this name.

purpose.description: One line describing the repository's function in the workspace.

ref.description: Branch for workingTree; selected version for pinned mode.

mode.description: Omit to infer pinned when a lock exists, workingTree otherwise. Explicit modes require matching lock presence.

specRepository.description: Describes the repository containing project.json. It may also contain product code.

agents.description: Local agent integrations. Omit for all supported integrations or use [] to disable them.

specRepository.description: Describes the repository containing project.json. It may also contain product code.

repositories.description: Other repositories in the workspace. Names and paths must be distinct, and paths must not reuse the spec or guidelines directory or the reserved roles directory.

url.description: HTTPS, SSH or local Git source without credentials. Relative references resolve against the spec source.

path.description: Directory in the project root. Defaults to name.

skills.description: The repository's own skill directory, relative to the repository, for example spec/skills. Requires CretSpec 0.6.0 or later.

version3.description: Version 2 plus typed references. Requires CretSpec 0.8.0 or later; cspec project migrate converts version 2.

repositories.description: Code repositories, further guidelines and referenced CretSpec projects. A referenced project's own references are resolved as well; a cycle is an error.

type.description: code: a repository of the workspace. guidelines: further guidance with instructions and skills. project: another CretSpec project.

url.description: HTTPS, SSH or local Git source without credentials. Relative references resolve against the spec source.

path.description: Directory in the project root. Defaults to name.

skills.description: Code: the repository's own skill directory, for example spec/skills. Guidelines: the skill directory, by default skills. Not valid for projects.

ref.description: Guidelines, required: the branch of a working tree, or the selected version when commit pins it.

commit.description: Guidelines: the exact commit that pins this reference.

scope.description: Guidelines: the repositories of this definition where the guidance applies. Omit to apply it everywhere.

priority.description: Guidelines and projects: a higher priority comes earlier in the precedence order, together with everything a referenced project brings. Defaults to 0; ties keep declaration order, with the project's own guidelines first.

instructions.description: Guidelines: files to read, relative to the repository. Defaults to README.md, guidelines/principles.md, guidelines/specification.md and the selected profiles.
